title: Refactor Semio UI to Use Elements UI Only
description: Extend Semio Ui Components For Iframe And Create Scene And Design Components
summary: Refactored semio/ui to inherit styling from elements/ui by removing semio/ui-owned CSS vars, moving them into elements/ui/globals.css, and rewriting KitArtifactSelect to compose elements/ui primitives (Section, Button, ToggleGroup) instead of inline styles + Tailwind strings.
